What Bright Winter looks like

Your defining quality is brilliance: striking contrast between dark hair and light or luminous skin, and eyes that look jewel-bright. Saturated, icy-clear colours such as hot pink, cobalt, bright emerald and lemon, worn with black and optic white, make you look vivid and awake, while dusty, earthy or muted colours make you look flat and tired.

Colours Bright Winter should avoid

Dusty Mauve. Greyed and soft; it dims your natural brightness.

Mushroom. Flat, muted beige that makes you look tired.

Best metals

Best: Polished silver. Good: White gold and platinum. Skip: Matte antique brass.

Questions

What colours look best on Bright Winter?

Bright Winter suits colours that are cool-neutral, medium and bright, such as silver, hot pink, scarlet, icy lemon, spearmint.

What colours should Bright Winter avoid?

Dusty Mauve: Greyed and soft; it dims your natural brightness. Mushroom: Flat, muted beige that makes you look tired.

Gold or silver for Bright Winter?

Best: Polished silver. Also good: white gold and platinum. Usually skip: matte antique brass.

How do I know if I'm Bright Winter?

Bright Winter colouring is cool-neutral in undertone, medium in depth, high in contrast and bright in chroma. A daylight selfie scan measures all four and shows your closest season plus a runner-up.
